claims: The No. 7 seed Illinois Fighting Illini defeated the No. 10 seed Colorado Buffaloes 66-57 in a first-round matchup of the 2026 NCAA Women's Basketball Tournament.
The matchup took place on March 21, 2026.
The matchup was held at Vanderbilt’s Memorial Gym.
Illinois advanced to the second round for the second consecutive season.
This marked the first postseason meeting between Illinois Fighting Illini and Colorado Buffaloes, according to University of Illinois Athletics.
